title: Inspiration Sessions
lead: Curated presentations and experiences that inspire teams and leadership to embrace new ways of working and technology-driven change.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Inspiration sessions are structured sessions designed to shift mindsets and build appetite for change. They combine external perspectives, case studies, emerging trends and interactive elements to challenge assumptions and open up new possibilities. They are typically used early in a transformation engagement.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Inspiration sessions are used in ITOM engagements to create urgency and openness for change. They are particularly effective with leadership teams who need to understand why the current operating model needs to change and what the future could look like.
